_4_.TextA: D-Reaper was a program that purged a memory area when the data exceeded a set quota. You remember, right? It sure is nostalgic.

_5_.TextA: Nostalgic? Stop fooling around! D-Reaper existed long before we began our research on Digimon!

_6_.TextA: That's right. But why did it come all of a sudden now..

_7_.TextA: Use of the computer network spread rapidly as people began to use it for pratical purposes.

_8_.TextA: The Digimon evolved and grew in number too fast… So D-Reaper started moving, in order to erase them?

_9_.TextA: Yes. And now that the Digital World and the real world are connected, the aftermath of the D-Reaper has crossed over to the real world beyond the Digital World. For D-Reapers, Real World must be full of things that must be eliminated.

_10_.TextA: That's why they're rampaging like that in the Real World.. How can I stop it?

_0_.TextA: Some unidentified beings have been appearing from the Digital World. Are they Digimon once again? On this issue, we will ask Professor Rob McCoy, who developed and researched the Digimon.

_1_.TextA: Those beings are completely different from the Digimon. Compared to what they were when we researched them, the Digimon have indeed accomplished rapid evolution and built their own world apart from the network.

_2_.TextA: I see.

_3_.TextA: Still, Digimon were originally created to communicated with humans, especially children, and evolve to stronger, more complex beings, and they would never do something like erase our world.

_4_.TextA: So.. Why is that behavioral object attacking us?

_5_.TextA: That thing in West Shinjuku is an entirely differnet beast a primitive deletion program called the D-Reaper, which we believe evolved in an abnormal way.

_6_.TextA: So how did the D-Reaper evolve? What features did it have? I would like to ask Professor Curly, a colleague of Professor McCoy's, about this.

_7_.TextA: Originally, D-Reaper was only responsible for the aforementioned task of setting the memory field to zero. However, all it needed to do was absorb a Digimon on the network, learn their capabilities, and it could create an Agent in order to move actively around.

_8_.TextA: I see. Professor Dolphin and Professor Curly, thank you for your reply.

_0_.TextA: Hmm.. Is really is a primitive AI?

_1_.TextA: The thing you saw in the Digital World and this one… are they the same?

_2_.TextA: No. Well.. They are basically the same,

_3_.TextA: What's difference?

_4_.TextA: but the one in the Digital World deleted any data in touched. On the other hand, what we have here..
